seoTitle: Free Habit Streak Tracker, Saved in Your Browser
metaDescription: Track daily habits, see your current and best streak and the last 14 days at a glance. Free tracker that stores data only in this browser.
intro: Add habits, tick them off each day and see your current streak, best streak and total days. A 14-day strip shows recent progress, and data is saved only in this browser.
why: Habit apps often ask for an account, notifications and a subscription, when all most people want is a checklist that shows how many days in a row they have kept going. This tracker offers exactly that. Add a habit such as reading or stretching, press Done today, and it works out your current streak, your best ever run and the total number of days. A strip of filled and empty squares shows the last two weeks so a missed day is obvious. Everything is saved in your browser's local storage, which means no sign-in and no sync: the data stays on this device and browser, and clearing site data or switching browsers starts afresh.
howTo: Type a habit name and press 'Add habit'.
Press 'Done today' each day you complete it; press again to undo.
Check the streak, best streak, total and the 14-day strip, or press Delete to remove a habit.

faq.q: How is the current streak counted?
faq.a: As consecutive days ending today. If you have not ticked today yet, the streak still counts up to yesterday, so it does not drop to zero until a full day is missed.
In your browser's local storage on this device. It is not uploaded, not synced between devices and not backed up. Clearing site data, or using a private window, will delete it.

faq.q: Can I mark an earlier day?
faq.a: No. You can only mark or unmark today. The strip shows the past 14 days, but past days cannot be edited.

faq.q: What if I use the tracker on another device?
faq.a: You will start with an empty list there, because nothing syncs. Use one browser consistently for the history to make sense.
